test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A bank offers compound interest at the rate 5% per annum calculated half yearly on its deposits. A customer deposits Rs. 2,400 each on 1st January and 1st July of a year. Find the amount be received at the end of the year.
solution:
**Given:**

A bank offers compound interest at the rate of 5% per annum calculated half-yearly on its deposits. A customer deposits Rs. 2,400 each on 1st January and 1st July of a year.

**Concept:**

Compound Interest is calculated using the formula:

A = P(1 + r/n)ⁿt

Where:

 
• A = Amount
 
• P = Principal
 
• r = Annual interest rate (decimal)
 
• n = Number of times interest is compounded per year
 
• t = Time the money is invested for in years

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + r/n)ⁿt

**Calculation:**

For the deposit on 1st January:

⇒ P = Rs. 2,400, r = 5/100 = 0.05, n = 2, t = 1 year

⇒ A₁ = 2400(1 + 0.05/2)²×¹

⇒ A₁ = 2400(1 + 0.025)²

⇒ A₁ = 2400(1.025)²

⇒ A₁ = 2400 × 1.050625

⇒ A₁ ≈ Rs. 2521.50

For the deposit on 1st July:

⇒ P = Rs. 2,400, r = 0.05, n = 2, t = 0.5 years

⇒ A₂ = 2400(1 + 0.05/2)²×⁰.⁵

⇒ A₂ = 2400(1 + 0.025)¹

⇒ A₂ = 2400 × 1.025

⇒ A₂ ≈ Rs. 2460

Total Amount at the end of the year:

⇒ Total Amount = A₁ + A₂

⇒ Total Amount ≈ 2521.50 + 2460

⇒ Total Amount ≈ Rs. 4,981.50

**∴ The customer will receive Rs. 4,981.50 at the end of the year.**
